citations.claim: EW was green at step 122 then yellow at step 123, showing normal cycle before preemption
EW yellow at step 123 cut after 1s when emergency for S became active
NS green at first violating step 124 with 0s all-red, emergency active

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event; otherwise identical. Without preemption the cycle proceeds normally and no violation occurs.

explanation: Emergency preemption forces the emergency direction to green immediately. At step 122 EW green, at 123 EW yellow with emergency active, at 124 NS green. The controller skipped the required yellow (6s) and all-red (2s), causing all_red_clearance (0s vs 2s) and yellow_duration failures.

violation.detail: approach 0 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 2 s)

vision_note: Steps 121-122 show green for one direction with the cross direction red, then step 123 shows that same direction turning yellow. Step 124 immediately shows green for the opposite direction with no intervening all-red clearance.
